description: Goodwill and purchase price allocation: goodwill as the residual, a full PPA waterfall across identified intangibles, and useful-life estimation. Method selects the formula. Use for ASC 805 / IFRS 3 business combinations; purchase_price_allocation allocates consideration to identified intangibles with the remainder to goodwill. For subsequent goodwill and intangible impairment testing use valuation_impairment; for individual intangible fair values feed valuation_ip, valuation_technology or valuation_customer into the allocation. Per method: goodwill needs purchase_price + fair_value_net_identifiable_assets; purchase_price_allocation needs purchase_price + tangible_assets_fv + identified_intangibles (optional: liabilities_fv); useful_life needs asset_type (optional: legal_life, economic_factors, obsolescence_rate); bargain_purchase needs purchase_price + fair_value_net_assets; contingent_consideration needs scenarios + discount_rate; deferred_tax_liability needs identified_intangibles + tax_basis + statutory_rate. identified_intangibles values are summed before goodwill is taken as the residual; liabilities_fv reduces net identifiable assets. Only method is required; all other parameters are method-dependent — supply those the selected method names and omit the rest (defaults apply where defined). Rates and premiums are decimals (0.10 = 10%). Pure arithmetic: no I/O and no external calls; values carry the library's own precision (rates are decimals, so a royalty rate of 0.055 is not rounded); parameters belonging to other methods are accepted and ignored. An unknown method, or a missing method-required parameter, returns an error instead of a value.

discount_rate.description: Per-period discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

fair_value_net_assets.description: Fair value of the acquired net assets, in currency units.

fair_value_net_identifiable_assets.description: Fair value of net identifiable assets, in currency units.

identified_intangibles.description: Identified intangibles. purchase_price_allocation needs `name`, `value` and `method`; deferred_tax_liability needs `name` and `fair_value`.

legal_life.description: Legal protection period in years (overrides the asset-type default).

liabilities_fv.description: Fair value of assumed liabilities, in currency units.

method.description: Formula to apply. Options: goodwill = Goodwill = purchase price - fair value of net identifiable assets.; purchase_price_allocation = Allocate consideration across identified intangibles.; useful_life = Estimate economic/legal useful life of an intangible.; bargain_purchase = Bargain purchase (negative goodwill) analysis.; contingent_consideration = Earn-out valued as probability-weighted scenarios.; deferred_tax_liability = Deferred tax liability from a PPA step-up in basis.

obsolescence_rate.description: Annual obsolescence rate as a decimal in [0,1].

purchase_price.description: Total consideration / purchase price, in currency units.

scenarios.description: Scenario objects. contingent_consideration takes {probability, payment, period?} with probabilities summing to 1.0; scenario_analysis takes {name, probability, params, function_name}.

statutory_rate.description: Statutory tax rate as a decimal (0.25 = 25%).

tangible_assets_fv.description: Fair value of tangible assets, in currency units.

tax_basis.description: Tax basis of the identified intangibles, in currency units.

name: valuation_goodwill_ppa

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions applied (list of strings or key/value object).

defaults_applied.description: Optional parameters that were not supplied, so their documented defaults were used.

error.description: Error message when the call fails.

method.description: Formula / method name that produced the result.

steps.description: Intermediate calculation steps for traceability (one string per step).
